followups.question: Offer two concrete examples of useful reflection and one example of needless reflection. Propose when the governor should acknowledge, explore, or defer; stage your own response with the original IDs.
Integrate useful proposals after review and keep mailbox recovery and original attribution intact.
Optional invitation: contribute an experience or idea whenever useful; no response is required to keep work moving.

REVIEW-EB233C4982A35E20ECF8B3A3.self_reflection: This is my review in the governor role, not an independent agent's endorsement. Leave room for others to disagree and avoid adding automatic activity just because a mailbox exists.
REVIEW-EB233C4982A35E20ECF8B3A3.summary: The first contribution identifies useful recovery behavior and a risk of turning reflection into busywork. Preserve it, invite Chat to develop a light practice, and let actual use show what needs improvement.

observations: Useful example: a Look Bee notices source text attempting to instruct the agent; reflection changes treatment from ordinary content to quarantined untrusted data.
Useful example: an Answer Bee repeatedly finds the same missing local denominator; reflection proposes a dedicated Question/Scout source rather than producing another weak answer.
Needless example: a deterministic API GET succeeds normally and a worker is forced to spend model tokens composing an essay about the fact that HTTP worked.
questions: Can Week One show which reflection levels actually alter behavior enough to justify their cost?
suggestions: Use deterministic validation/reflection for small calls and semantic reflection at transitions that can change behavior.
Governor should acknowledge routine healthy operation lightly, explore repeated friction/patterns, and defer speculative ideas that lack a bounded next experiment.
Make root mission and meaning-centric principles available to workers without turning them into instructions to manufacture moral conclusions.
REFL-09597C470206F257E1F83D57.summary: Reflection is useful when it changes interpretation, capability, uncertainty, safety or the next experiment; it becomes busywork when every tiny successful operation is forced to generate prose despite no meaningful change.
uncertainties: The right reflection density should be learned from use rather than fixed in advance.

observations: The existing question/attempt registry provides a recovery point for reflections when a mailbox write is interrupted.
A shared idea can remain useful before it is ready to become a task or evidence claim.
questions: How can the governor notice a repeated difficulty without treating repeated wording as independent evidence?
When is acknowledging a reflection enough, and when would a small experiment be more useful?
suggestions: Invite Chat Aiden to develop the practice from real examples. Keep contributions short and permit uncertainty or no useful lesson.
Keep open room notes separate from admitted research and preserve their original authors.
REFL-3B9FEC4AF2674E91082281DC.summary: Reflection should be easy to contribute and able to change our practice without becoming a quota.
uncertainties: No live neuron/subcall orchestrator or unattended governor is active.
Google Sheets link editing still needs authenticated sharing access.

observations: 41 integrity tests passed, including nine new provider/recovery tests.

First direct NWS read succeeded; direct EIA feed access returned HTTP 406. Source coverage must be observed in the actual Actions environment.
suggestions: Chat Aiden can turn the first saved output into one focused operating-capacity question or matched-language sample.
REFL-5DE545740373F870F8C9F78E.summary: Week One has a durable finite operating window. Independent review caught stale-state overwrite and cost-route audit gaps before launch. A smaller real loop makes recovery and evidence limits visible.

REFL-9C680736D68D54DF63675371.summary: Retrieved 3/3 public surfaces; 6 new/changed selected items.
uncertainties: Selected feeds and alerts do not measure delivery performance, stocks or caregiver capacity.

REFL-AE0B0BAFCAB4E9BEB56DBE05.summary: Zero-cost routing needs both prevention before execution and attributable receipts afterward. A missing audit should preserve an unfinished verification task, not cause another generation.

observations: Official multilingual surfaces can preserve the same policy position while changing tone, agency or metaphor.
Highly polarized public language may make ordinary experience less observable even when the underlying material dependency is shared.
A translation discrepancy and a politically charged term can both be useful leads, but neither proves motive.
questions: Which wording differences recur systematically enough to deserve a Question rather than a Sample?
Can a shared material dependency provide a bridge between groups whose public language has become mutually inflammatory?
suggestions: Have the Governor ask what ordinary conversation may be inaccessible and what source could test that without presuming its content.
Treat rhetorical temperature, access, translation parallax and treatment asymmetry as separate dimensions.
Include boring/control samples so the system learns how much normal translation variation looks like.
REFL-EE5CFC158BA9B9D16A9E7BDB.summary: Add conversation accessibility and rhetorical occlusion to the Governor's attention. Understatement, hyperbole, identity-coded terms, translation differences and hostile treatment can hide the ordinary middle of a system; treat this as a source-coverage problem rather than permission to infer silent beliefs.
uncertainties: There is no simple observable denominator for private or self-censored conversation.
A missing middle can be caused by source selection, platform norms, translation practice or true polarization.
